name: Riccardo Galbiati
headline: MSc Media & Creative Industries
focus: Market Research · Quantitative Research · Consumer Insights
profile: Early-career consumer insights and market research graduate with an MSc in Media & Creative Industries and a BSc in Economics & Business. Hands-on experience designing surveys in Qualtrics, analysing quantitative data in SPSS and translating results into clear research conclusions. Experienced in qualitative interviews, audience research and applying insights to campaign positioning. Interested in rapid, practical research that helps brands test ideas and make informed decisions.

projects.title: Master's Thesis
projects.summary: Designed a consumer survey with 315 participants, using SPSS regression and mediation analysis to identify key drivers of audience loyalty and disengagement, with a model explaining 59.1% of variance in disengagement intentions.

projects.title: Jera On Air
projects.summary: Co-developed an integrated marketing campaign proposal for a music festival attracting 40,000+ annual visitors, targeting consumers aged 20–25 across 3 countries through a multi-channel strategy, 3 brand extension concepts and 2 potential brand partnerships.

projects.title: Pre-Master Research
projects.summary: Conducted 10 in-depth consumer interviews and identified 4 key behavioural themes influencing brand authenticity, perceived value and audience preferences, translating qualitative findings into insights for audience positioning.

projects.title: Live Music Ticket Pricing
projects.summary: Analysed industry reports and news articles, identifying 6 recurring explanations for rising concert prices; found market concentration featured in 83% of the articles, alongside production costs and changing consumer demand.

experience.summary: Retail operations and customer support in a high-volume supermarket, including stock management and making sure products are stored in the right categories in the warehouse.
Supported daily farm and hospitality operations, including guest reception and general maintenance.
